comment: Every image the Temporal comparison race runs or builds from, pinned by multi-architecture index digest. A digest bump is a reviewed pull request. temporal_compare.py refuses any harness Dockerfile base or Compose service image that is not listed here or built by the harness.

temporal.use: Temporal CLI 1.10.1 (Server 1.32.2) running start-dev on a SQLite file

roadrunner.use: RoadRunner binary for the Temporal PHP SDK workers

php.use: PHP runtime for both worker images

composer.use: Installs the worker lock files at build time only

rust-builder.use: Builds the native Server (Dockerfile.native build stage)

uv.use: Load generator runtime; uv installs scripts/perf/uv.lock
